zh: 一个AI读过一万篇地质论文，
en: An AI has read 10,000 geology papers,

zh: 但它从来没看到过一条地震波。
en: but it has never seen a seismic wave.

zh: 你觉得它真的懂地球吗？
en: Does it really understand the Earth?

zh: 这两天，2026世界人工智能大会正在上海举行。
en: The 2026 World AI Conference is being held in Shanghai.

zh: 我看完大会资料，发现这个问题不只属于科学家，
en: After reading the materials, I realized this is not only a question for scientists.

zh: 它跟普通人的工作关系很大。
en: It is closely tied to the work of ordinary people.

zh: 换到我们身边，你想一下就明白了。
en: Bring it back to daily life, and the point becomes clear.

zh: 一个AI读完所有的设备维修手册，
en: An AI may read every equipment repair manual,

zh: 但它从来没有听到过机器坏掉之前的那一声异响。
en: yet never hear the strange sound just before a machine fails.

zh: 它读过所有的种植教材，
en: It may read every farming textbook,

zh: 但它没见过今年这块地的叶色、土壤和天气变化。
en: but never see this year's leaf color, soil, and weather changes.

zh: 你说它真的懂制造业，懂农业吗？
en: Does it really understand manufacturing or agriculture?

zh: 所以，我看这次大会最关心的就是，
en: So this is what I cared about most at the conference:

zh: 当这些技术进入工厂、农田、物流、药房和门店以后，
en: when these technologies enter factories, farms, logistics, pharmacies, and stores,

zh: 普通人手里的经验到底会发生什么变化。
en: what happens to the experience held by ordinary workers?

zh: 先说一个我们经常听到的词，数据。
en: Start with a word we hear all the time: data.

zh: 一说数据，很多人想到的是表格、报表和电脑里的数字。
en: For many people, data means tables, reports, and numbers on a computer.

zh: 但在工厂里，数据可能是机器突然多出来的一声杂音，
en: In a factory, data may be a new noise from a machine,

zh: 是轴承连续几天的振动变化。
en: or a bearing's vibration changing over several days.

zh: 到了农田，它可能是叶片颜色、土壤湿度和一场雨之后的涨势。
en: On a farm, it may be leaf color, soil moisture, and growth after rain.

zh: 放到冷链里，它又变成了一条温度曲线。
en: In cold-chain logistics, it becomes a temperature curve.

zh: 这些东西很多根本不是先以文字出现的，
en: Much of this does not first appear as text.

zh: 它们先发生在现场。
en: It happens in the field first.

zh: 真正干过这一行的人，先看见，
en: People who know the trade see it first,

zh: 先听见，先觉得哪里不对，
en: hear it first, and sense that something is wrong.

zh: 最后才有人把其中一部分写进报告和手册。
en: Only later is part of it written into reports and manuals.

zh: 这也是王坚在演讲里讲科学数据时最打动我的地方。
en: That is what moved me most in Wang Jian's talk on scientific data.

zh: 今天的大语言模型很会读文字，
en: Today's large language models are very good at reading text.

zh: 它可以读论文、网页和说明书，
en: They can read papers, web pages, and manuals.

zh: 但它读别人写下的结论，
en: But reading someone else's conclusion

zh: 不等于它已经直接看过结论背后的观测。
en: is not the same as seeing the observation behind it.

zh: 地球发生的是震动，望远镜收到的是红外信号，
en: The Earth moves; telescopes receive infrared signals.

zh: 工厂设备留下的是声音和温度曲线。
en: Machines leave sounds and temperature curves.

zh: AI如果真想进入这些行业，
en: If AI truly enters these industries,

zh: 就要开始处理这些现场留下来的东西。
en: it must begin processing what the field leaves behind.

zh: 演讲里提到一个很有意思的例子：
en: The talk gave a fascinating example:

zh: 一名十八岁的学生马泰奥·帕兹，
en: an eighteen-year-old student, Mateo Paz,

zh: 使用已经退役的NEOWISE红外望远镜留下的十年观测数据，
en: used ten years of data from the retired NEOWISE infrared telescope

zh: 开发了一套机器学习方法。
en: to develop a machine-learning method.

zh: 这套方法会寻找红外测量中的很细微的变化，
en: It searched for subtle changes in infrared measurements

zh: 最后标记并分类大约一百五十万个潜在新目标。
en: and flagged about 1.5 million potential new targets.

zh: 这里的潜在新目标不等于一百五十万个已经逐个确认的新天体。
en: Potential targets do not mean 1.5 million individually confirmed new objects.

zh: 真正值得看的是望远镜已经退役十年的数据也没有变，
en: The telescope was retired and the ten-year dataset did not change.

zh: 变的是观察这些数据的方法。
en: What changed was the way people examined the data.

zh: 过去有没有被整理出来的变化，
en: Patterns that had not been organized before

zh: 开始有机会被看见。
en: now had a chance to be seen.

zh: 这个例子离我们很远吗？
en: Does this example feel far removed from us?

zh: 看起来其实是在讲天文，
en: It may sound like astronomy,

zh: 但是它提醒了我们一件很具体的事。
en: but it points to something very concrete.

zh: 一个行业真正有价值的信息未必写在文件里。
en: An industry's most valuable information may never be written in a file.

zh: 工厂老师傅听到机器的声音不对，
en: An experienced technician hears that a machine sounds wrong.

zh: 他脑子里判断的不只是一句设备可能坏了，
en: He is not merely thinking, “the machine may fail.”

zh: 他在比较这台机器平时怎么响，
en: He compares how this machine normally sounds,

zh: 今天哪里变了，这里变化以前对应过什么问题。
en: what changed today, and what that change meant before.

zh: 如果AI以后要帮忙识别这些设备异常，
en: If AI is to identify equipment anomalies,

zh: 光读维修手册远远不够，
en: reading maintenance manuals is nowhere near enough.

zh: 声音要被记录正常和异常也要有说明。
en: Sounds must be recorded, with normal and abnormal cases explained.

zh: 模型找出的结果还要有懂设备的人回到现场复核。
en: People who understand the equipment must verify the model's result on site.

zh: 这次大会上还有一个机器人智慧药房，
en: The conference also featured a robotic smart pharmacy.

zh: 不同的机器人连续完成接单、取货和交付，
en: Different robots handled orders, picking, and delivery in sequence.

zh: 它们直接进入已有门店和工作人员、顾客在同一个环境里工作，
en: They entered an existing store and worked beside staff and customers.

zh: 夜间还会协助药剂师分拣药品。
en: At night, they also helped pharmacists sort products.

zh: 我觉得这里最值得看的不是机器人会不会走路，
en: The important point is not whether a robot can walk.

zh: 而是它怎样进入原来的药房流程。
en: It is how the robot enters the pharmacy's existing workflow.

zh: 机器人在干活，药剂师仍然在场，
en: The robot works, while the pharmacist remains present.

zh: 它展示的是协助，不是把人直接从药房里删除。
en: This demonstrates assistance, not removing people from the pharmacy.

zh: 所以普通人看这种大会，
en: So ordinary people do not need to feel excluded by such conferences.

zh: 不用因为看见大模型、机器人和各种行业专业名词，
en: Do not let models, robots, and technical terms

zh: 就觉得这些是工程师或者是科学家的事。
en: make you think this belongs only to engineers and scientists.

zh: AI可能读过比我们很多的资料，
en: AI may have read far more material than we have,

zh: 但它不会自动知道工厂里的哪一声异响值得紧急，
en: but it cannot automatically know which factory noise is urgent,

zh: 地里的哪一种叶色需要警惕，
en: which leaf color signals danger,

zh: 冷链里的哪一段温度变化不能放过去。
en: or which cold-chain temperature change cannot be ignored.

zh: 真正干过这一行的人，不是在AI之外，
en: People who know the trade are not outside the AI loop.

zh: 他要告诉AI看什么，什么算异常，
en: They tell AI what to watch and what counts as abnormal.

zh: 最后还要判断AI给出的结果到底能不能信。
en: They also decide whether the result can be trusted.

zh: 当然，这不等于只要有经验就一定不会被技术改变。
en: Of course, experience alone does not make anyone immune to change.

zh: 经验如果永远留在一个人的脑子里，
en: If experience stays forever in one person's head,

zh: 别人看不见，系统也学不到。
en: others cannot see it, and systems cannot learn it.

zh: 一个老师傅离开岗位后，
en: When an experienced worker leaves,

zh: 很多为什么一听就不对的判断，
en: many judgments that once felt instantly obvious

zh: 新人可能根本接不上。
en: may never reach the next person.

zh: AI真正有用的地方，可能是把这些声音、图像和变化持续记录下来，
en: AI can help by continuously recording sounds, images, and changes,

zh: 让经验有机会被比较、被复核。
en: so experience can be compared and reviewed.

zh: 但至少我们可以重新认识自己的工作。
en: At the very least, we can look at our own work differently.

zh: 你每天一眼就能看出来，
en: What you can spot at a glance,

zh: 一听就觉得不对，外行人却完全注意不到的东西，
en: or hear as wrong while outsiders notice nothing,

zh: 很可能就是这个行业过去没有被认真记录的现场数据。
en: may be field data your industry never seriously recorded.

zh: AI真正进入这个行业以前，
en: Before AI truly enters that industry,

zh: 需要逐步学习处理的东西。
en: it must gradually learn to process those signals.

zh: 这就是我从这次上海世界人工智能大会里给普通人的一个判断。
en: That is my takeaway for ordinary people from the Shanghai conference.

zh: AI进入各个行业，最后都要回到现场。
en: When AI enters an industry, it must eventually return to the field.

zh: 模型提供能力，真正干过这一行的人决定什么值得看，
en: Models provide capability; practitioners decide what matters,

zh: 什么算错，结果能不能用。
en: what is wrong, and whether the result can be used.

zh: 关注我，我是超哥，在兰州AI创业。
en: Follow me. I am Chao, building with AI in Lanzhou.
